en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. It was narrated to me by Ja’far b. Muhammad from ’Ubayd-Allah from Abdillah b. Maymun al-Qadah from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said:
“Nothing in this universe except Allah, knows the reward of feeding a Muslim to satiation.
Feeding a Muslim is one of the deeds of being forgiven of one’s sins.”
Imam recited the verse: ‘…Or the giving of food in a day of hunger to an orphan, having relationship, or to the poor man lying in the dust.”13
